messages:
maria: FYI customer (EU fintech) asked for a single-paragraph answer for their security questionnaire: can we guarantee that ALL inference compute, request/response logs, and diagnostic traces remain in the EU for the 14-day POC? They also want the subprocessor roster and a rough delta on cost if we enforce EU-only routing. Kickoff Wed AM. cc @kevin @priya :wave:
kevin: Short: yes we can run a EU-only POC. For hosted API you set X-Redwood-Region-Preference: eu and pass fail_if_unavailable=true to prevent cross-region fallback. With that flag set a saturated EU pool will return 503s instead of routing to non-EU pools.
priya: Exporting subprocessor CSV now. Current EU subprocessors relevant to the request: EU CSP (eu-west-1/3), EU CDN partner (FR/DE/IE POPs), EU observability (metrics only), EU-managed backup provider (encryption at rest). No third-party receives full request/response payloads. I'll upload to /legal/attachments and DM the NDA link.
otis: Operational note: we also have model variants hosted in EU and EU-only KV cache. For POC we can pin model_variant: gpt-like-eu-v1 per session to avoid implicit model routing. Example header/curl:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Region-Preference: eu" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Fail-If-Unavailable: true" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-like-eu-v1","input":"..."}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
maria: Helpful. They also want to know if telemetry (metrics/alerts) is ever replicated outside EU for platform analytics. Need a yes/no with a single sentence explanation.
priya: Answer: by default some aggregated platform analytics are replicated to US for billing/ops, but for enterprise POCs we can disable cross-border telemetry replication and limit retention; contractually enforceable. I'll add that caveat to the CSV line items.
kevin: Pricing: ad-hoc hosted eu-only routing typically increases per-token unit cost ~6-14% due to EU capacity pricing and reduced opportunistic routing. If they want a hard SOW price we should provision a small reserved pool (1xA100 or 2xA10 depending on throughput) for the POC and quote a short-term commit which usually neutralizes most of the delta.
maria: They asked about egress/cdn costs too — do we incur extra CDN egress in EU vs global?
priya: CDN egress within EU is subject to regional CSP pricing; in practice egress to EU POPs tends to be slightly cheaper than cross-region egress but depends on customer's provider peering. We'll include a line in the SOW: "Customer is responsible for any third-party egress charges; Redwood does not mark up CDN egress."
finance-bot: Automated: provisional cost estimate template created at /finance/drafts/eu-poc-1800004321.csv. Use "hosted-eu-only" tab for quick numbers.
kevin: For quick SOW I recommend two options in the doc: (A) Hosted EU-bias with fail_if_unavailable=true (+estimated 8-12% per-token) and (B) Reserved short-term commit (2x A10/A100) — fixed daily rate. Which do they prefer?
maria: I'll propose both and highlight the trade-offs (latency risk vs cost predictability). Also they want a single-line infosec answer: "Are payloads sent to third-party SaaS?" Need a yes/no.
priya: One-liner: "No — full request/response payloads are not forwarded to third-party SaaS; we only send aggregated telemetry (latency/error metrics) which can be restricted for the POC."
maria: Perfect. Can someone attach the CSV and NDA link now? We need to send this to the customer in 30 mins.
legal-bot: Automated: NDA-EU-POC-1800004321.pdf uploaded to /legal/attachments/POC-1800004321 . Tag with customer name to generate SOW stub.
infra-bot: Provisioning: eu-poc-namespace requested by maria scheduled for 2026-11-02T06:30Z. ETA ~9m.
otis: Also note that if they require KMS in their tenancy we can run Private deployment or arrange BYOK for Dedicated — that'll change lead time and cost.
kevin: I'll DM maria a short cost table for hosted vs reserved including potential CDN egress assumptions.
maria: Great work. I'll send the customer: 1) one-line infosec bullets, 2) subprocessor CSV link, 3) SOW options A/B + cost ballpark. Thanks team :thumbsup:
